summary: Heal/Blessing/AGI-Up bot: makes every melee partner twice as effective and potion-free. Scales entirely on INT/DEX (cast) and party uptime.

reveal + make Holy Water for Aspersio later

do_not_waste: Decrease AGI (needs IncAgi 1; PvP tool, weak vs mobs)
Signum Crucis chain (Demon Bane 3, screen-wide undead-only)
Holy Light before job 50 (quest; SP 15 for 125% MATK with an INT-lean build)
renewal_differences: Heal diverges by era: pre-re amount = floor((BLv+INT)/8)*(4+8lv) (rathena skill.cpp:70) vs renewal (BLv+INT)/5*30*lv/10 (the formula the corpus page shows). Angelus in pre-re raises soft DEF by 5%/lv; renewal replaced much of that with %HP. Blessing/AGI-Up values are era-stable.
